subject.title: fix: bind Azure disk cleanup to durable claims

question: Should Crabbox accept this durable-claim model for Azure Worker managed-disk cleanup, including fail-closed handling when no claim can prove an orphaned disk after VM deletion?
rationale: The patch fixes a destructive cleanup authorization gap, but it also changes recovery behavior for existing or interrupted cleanups that only have Crabbox-written tags.

options.title: Accept durable-claim boundary
options.body: Merge after normal checks with the understood tradeoff that unprovable Azure disk cleanup must stop for trusted operator handling.

options.title: Require upgrade note first
options.body: Ask for a short operator-facing note explaining how pre-claim interrupted Azure cleanup residue should be resolved.

options.title: Pause for another recovery model
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want automatic legacy orphan recovery instead of fail-closed behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept durable-claim boundary
recommendation.body: Merge after normal checks with the understood tradeoff that unprovable Azure disk cleanup must stop for trusted operator handling.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent Azure cleanup hardening on current main and merged the adjacent exact-claim work.
